A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the current network of PAs is not enough to protect the mammal fauna of the Brazilian Amazon under climate change, and that the establishment of a network of protected areas that includes indigenous lands is a good strategy to protect mammals under climate change.
, if we want to save the most species in the Brazilian Amazon, we should act in a proactive/reactive manner, i.e., protect both climate refugia priority and high-risk areas.

, in the context of the Brazilian Amazon, a proactive strategy is the most efficient way to protect the largest number of species, while a reactive strategy would protect the highest number of threatened species.
